pubmed_europe_pmc_records.title: High-throughput immunoassay through in-channel microfluidic patterning
pubmed_europe_pmc_records.authors: Zheng C, Wang J, Pang Y, Wang J, Li W, Ge Z, Huang Y
pubmed_europe_pmc_records.licence: Royal Society of Chemistry (Cited Protocol Source)
pubmed_europe_pmc_records.key_findings: Specifies 10 min BSA blocking, 15 min capture antibody (500 µg/mL), 15 min sample incubation (1:1 serum in PBS), 10 min detection antibody (125 µg/mL), and 3 min PBS washes at 25 °C. Under-incubation (<13 min) or over-incubation (>17 min) causes incomplete surface adsorption, replicate spot variance, and false concentration readings.

pubmed_europe_pmc_records.title: Artificial Intelligence-Controlled Microfluidic Device for Fluid Automation and Bubble Removal of Immunoassay Operated by a Smartphone
pubmed_europe_pmc_records.authors: Bhuiyan NH, Hong JH, Uddin MJ, Shim JS
pubmed_europe_pmc_records.key_findings: Demonstrates that trapped air microbubbles and incomplete channel filling (gas slugs) in microfluidic immunoassay channels physically mask patterned capture spots and scatter optical readout signals, requiring bubble removal or channel re-filling before readout.

pubmed_europe_pmc_records.title: Artificial intelligence performance in testing microfluidics for point-of-care
pubmed_europe_pmc_records.authors: Doganay MT, Chakraborty P, Bommakanti SM, et al.
pubmed_europe_pmc_records.key_findings: Transparent bubbles create refractive index boundaries and variable light scattering; wall glare and underexposed camera frames challenge optical classification and require image quality gating.

uniprot_alphafold_records.protein_name: Carcinoembryonic antigen-related cell adhesion molecule 5 (CEACAM5 / CEA)

biophysical_properties.thermal_sensitivity_note: Heavy N-linked glycosylation (60% carbohydrate by weight) stabilizes IgV-like N-domain, but ambient excursions >=30 °C accelerate off-rate (k_off) of capture/detection mAb complexes and increase non-specific serum background binding.
Pentameric calcium-dependent ligand binding; requires strict pH 7.2-7.4 PBS/BSA diluent and complete 3x Tween-20 washing to prevent monomeric dissociation.

pubchem_reagent_records.role_in_protocol: Sample dilution matrix (1:1 serum dilution) and 3-minute inter-step microfluidic channel wash buffer
pubchem_reagent_records.chemical_note: Skipping the 3-minute PBS wash (violation of c_06) leaves unbound serum proteins and free detection antibodies in the PDMS channel lumen, causing high non-specific fluorescence background across all channels.

pubchem_reagent_records.role_in_protocol: Non-ionic surfactant reducing gas-liquid interfacial tension and non-specific protein adsorption
pubchem_reagent_records.chemical_note: Low surfactant wetting or rapid syringe injection traps air pockets at hydrophobic PDMS channel corners (ref_02).
